content: Quarter 1. Text Focus: Poetry and Prose. Evaluate Afro-Asian literary texts within structural, biographical, historical, sociocultural, and linguistic contexts. Analyze maxims and philosophies. Identify purpose, compose, revise, and publish an original poem or prose reflecting expanding cultural identity. Pacing: Delivered over the quarter, integrating evaluation and publishing skills concurrently.
subject: English

content: Quarter 2. Text Focus: Persuasive Text. Evaluate informational texts for clarity, examining structures, linguistic features, and visual elements. Analyze supporting evidence, distinguish facts from opinions, evaluate claims, and analyze persuasive techniques (ethos, pathos, logos). Compose and publish multimodal persuasive texts. Pacing: Taught throughout the quarter, blending critical analysis with persuasive writing.
subject: English

content: Quarter 3. Text Focus: Opinion Editorials, Sports, Science & Tech Articles. Evaluate journalistic texts, examining structures and visual elements like photographs and cartoons. Extract information, determine veracity, assess journalistic quality, and synthesize data. Compose and publish multimodal opinion, sports, or science articles. Pacing: Quarter-long delivery focusing on media literacy and journalistic publishing.
subject: English

content: Quarter 4. Text Focus: Expository Essay, Letter of Inquiry. Evaluate academic and transactional texts. Examine text structures, discipline-specific words, and sender's voice. Analyze evidence, evaluate claims, and synthesize information. Compose, revise, and publish expository essays and formal letters of inquiry. Pacing: Delivered over the quarter, integrating academic writing and formal correspondence.
subject: English
